meta_description:
14K likes, 637 comments - daveramsey on March 29, 2025: "What an amazing week celebrating YOU on the Live Like No One Else Cruise!
 
It was a privilege to spend the week with you. Y’all are living proof that hard work, discipline, and financial peace are worth it! And a huge congratulations to everyone who participated in the world’s largest Debt-Free Scream. WOW, what an unforgettable moment.
 
I couldn’t be more proud of all of you and honored that you chose to spend this week with us. Thank you all again for making this an event we’ll all never forget. I hope you all had as much fun as I did!".
